# Security-critical vitest suites run as a required PR check.
# See .github/workflows/security-unit-tests.yml
#
# RULES
#   - One suite path per line, relative to the repo root. `#` starts a comment.
#   - Every path listed here MUST exist. The workflow fails if one is missing,
#     because `vitest run a.test.ts missing.test.ts` runs only `a` and exits 0 —
#     a renamed or deleted suite would otherwise silently drop coverage while CI
#     stayed green.
#   - Only add a suite that passes on `main`. A permanently-red required check
#     gets ignored, then bypassed, and then it is protecting nothing.
#
# Deliberately NOT the whole vitest suite: the repo has known-failing files
# (e.g. __tests__/shared-activity-rate-limit-cache.test.ts has 3 pre-existing
# failures on main). Running everything would make this red on arrival. Grow the
# list as suites are fixed.

# --- admin boundary -------------------------------------------------------
__tests__/admin-access-state.test.ts
__tests__/admin-auth-no-defaults.test.ts
__tests__/admin-bootstrap-route.test.ts
__tests__/admin-status-route.test.ts
__tests__/admin-metrics-route.test.ts

# --- route authorization --------------------------------------------------
__tests__/ai-phase2-routes-authz-contract.test.ts
__tests__/auth-entitlements.test.ts
__tests__/chimmy-action-permission-framework.test.ts
